ITEM 1 | Single strip of cooked meat with reddish-brown to dark mahogany color, glossy sheen with rendered fat edges, crisp-looking browned surface with some translucent pale fat areas at the ends, wavy irregular strip shape with a bend, roughly 13 cm long and 2.5 cm wide at its widest, lying flat on a white square plate covering about 15% of the plate's surface, approximately 0.5 cm thick, no visible breading or sauce | 14

ITEM 2 | Small irregular smear or crumb of orange-red residue, slightly glossy, about 1 cm across, sitting on the white plate to the upper left of the strip | 1
